mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease, it signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% year-over-year, it signals accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is decreasing and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is increasing, it signals a contractionary monetary policy in a weakening supply environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO decreases and FEDFUNDS increases.
